title: Sanskrit Pictionary
description: A real-time, team-based multiplayer educational game designed for learning Sanskrit vocabulary through drawing and guessing.
longDescription: This is a real-time, team-based multiplayer educational game built with React and Node.js. The application facilitates Sanskrit vocabulary learning by leveraging Socket.IO for high-frequency data relay, including live canvas synchronization and real-time lobby management. It features an automated, time-based scoring engine and an in-memory Game Session Manager to handle synchronized game states and rapid round transitions. Developed with a focus on responsive design and secure user sessions, the platform utilizes MongoDB for persistent data storage for both registered users and guests.

title: Personal Web (This Website)
longDescription: This is a professional portfolio platform designed to showcase my profile, detailed project experiences, and core technical competencies. The site demonstrates a full-stack integration by fetching dynamic content from multiple sources: the profile details in the header are retrieved through a Spring Boot REST API connected to an H2 SQL database, while the project gallery is managed via a cloud-based Firebase NoSQL database. To ensure high availability and scalability, the application is hosted on AWS, utilizing a combination of EC2 for the backend services and S3 for static web hosting. Furthermore, the platform implements a modern CI/CD pipeline through GitHub Actions, enabling automated testing and deployment to ensure the site is always up-to-date with the latest professional achievements.

description: A real-time, interactive 2D web game where players control a bird navigating through a dynamic environment.
frontend: Developed using ZIM.js (built on CreateJS) for high-performance HTML5 Canvas rendering and interactive component management.
longDescription: This is an interactive 2D web game that challenges players to navigate a bird through a dynamic, randomized environment filled with shifting clouds, buildings, and aircraft. The gameplay centers on a real-time collision system where players must collect healthy fruit to increase their score while avoiding junk food and lethal hazards. Using responsive keyboard controls with strictly defined movement boundaries, the game tracks player performance through a dual-scoring logic that triggers a "Game Over" if the bird crashes or consumes too much unhealthy food

longDescription: This is a robust, full-stack E-commerce platform that provides a secure, dynamic retail experience for small business owners. Built with a focus on reliability, the application features role-based authentication via Spring Security, a real-time product catalog with categorized browsing, and a persistent shopping cart system for a streamlined checkout process. All user profiles and transaction history are managed through a structured relational database to ensure data integrity and performance. The project is currently in progress, with future updates planned to integrate comprehensive user registration, automated email notifications, and secure payment gateway support via Stripe and PayPal.
